1. (Currently amended) A control system comprising:
a controller including a processor and memory, wherein the controller is communicatively coupled to automation components in the control system and configured to facilitate performance of a process through interoperation with the automation components by:
determining a model configured to describe the process used by the controller;
determining input and output variables of the process;
determining constraints on the input and output variables;
determining an objective function associated with the process used by the controller; and
storing the model, the input and output variables, the constraints, and the objective function in one of a plurality of fields in a holistic state data structure maintained in the memory, wherein the holistic state data structure is communicated to the automation components to enable the automation components to detect and operate with the controller upon receiving the holistic state data structure, and wherein the holistic state data structure comprises a standardized data format with predefined fields corresponding to the model, input and output variables, constraints, and objective function.

2. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a communication network and to transmit the holistic state data structure to each of the automation components upon connecting to the communication network.

3. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a backplane interface and to transmit the holistic state data structure to the automation components upon connecting to the backplane interface.

4. (Previously presented) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data is a standardized format understood by each of the automation components.

5. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is further configured to generate the holistic state data structure by:
determining an intermediate search result of an optimization search;
determining a state of the optimization search when the intermediate search result is determined; and
storing the intermediate search result and the state in an optimization state field of the holistic state data structure.

6. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data structure to facilitate performing an optimization search in conjunction with one or more of the automation components in the control system.

7. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is further configured to generate the holistic state data structure by:
determining computational capabilities of the controller;
determining interconnections with the automation components in the control system; and
storing the computational capabilities and the interconnections in a controller settings field of the holistic state data structure.

8. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to transmit the holistic state data structure to a server in the control system to facilitate determining an optimization problem.

9. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller comprises an in-memory database configured to store the holistic state data structure.

10. (Currently amended) A tangible, non-transitory computer-readable medium configured to store instructions executable by a processor of a controller, wherein the instructions comprise instructions to:
receive, using the processor, control system configuration data identifying automation components and their characteristics;
determine, using the processor, which automation components are communicatively coupled to the controller and determine characteristics of each of the automation components based at least in part on the control system configuration data;
determine, using the processor, an optimization problem based at least in part on the identified automation components and the characteristics of each of the automation components, wherein the optimization problem includes input and output variables, constraints, and an objective function;
generate a holistic state data structure comprising the optimization problem and the characteristics of the automation components in a standardized format; and
instruct, using the processor, one or more of the automation components to perform a control action in a process, wherein the control action is determined based at least in part on the optimization problem and the holistic state data structure.

11. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a model used by the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on the model used by each of the automation components.

12. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a computing capability of the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on computing capabilities of each of the automation components.

13. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the control system configuration data comprises a plurality of holistic state data structures, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data structures corresponds with one of the automation components.

14. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein the instructions to determine the automation components and characteristics of the automation components comprise instructions to parse each of the plurality of holistic state data structures.

15. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data structures comprises a standardized format with same predefined fields.

16. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the instructions to receive the configuration data comprise instructions to receive the configuration data from a cloud-based system.

17. (Currently amended) A method for performing diagnostics on a control system comprising:
capturing, using a processor of a controller in the control system, holistic state data that includes a model of the process, input and output variables, constraints, and an objective function;
simulating, using the processor, operation of the controller based at least in part on the holistic state data while the controller performs other operations, wherein the simulating comprises executing the model and objective function with the captured input and output variables and constraints;
analyzing, using the processor, results of the simulation to perform diagnostics on the controller; and
adjusting, using the processor, operation of the control system based at least in part on the diagnostics.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein:
simulating operation comprises simulating performance of various control actions by the controller using the model; and
analyzing the simulation comprises analyzing results of the various control actions.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein analyzing the simulation comprises:
determining a predicted response to a control action determined by the controller using the model;
comparing the predicted response with an actual response to the control action to determine accuracy of the model.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, comprising adjusting the model when the predicted response and the actual response vary by a threshold amount.
